newsitem.title: EGYPT: Alex Kuwait bank becomes Egyptian Commercial Bank.
newsitem.headline: Alex Kuwait bank becomes Egyptian Commercial Bank.

text.p: Shareholders of Alexandria Kuwait International Bank have agreed to change the name of the bank to Egyptian Commercial Bank to reflect the gradual change in ownership, general manager Nabil el-Minoufi said on Monday.
The bank began life in 1978 as a 51-49 joint venture between the Egyptian state's Bank of Alexandria and Kuwait investors.
Bank of Alexandria now owns less than 10 percent of the bank and Kuwait investors about five percent, Minoufi told Reuters.
"Now we are Egyptian and a commercial bank. So we are calling ourselves Egyptian Commercial Bank," he added.
The name change was approved at an extraordinary shareholders meeting on Sunday. It is effective immediately.
Minoufi said the bank's paid-in capital would rise to 125 million pounds ($36.8 million) from 100 million by the end of March as existing shareholders buy up their new shares.
The board of the bank will decide at its next meeting on the timing for the second stage of the capital increase, which will eventually take the capital up to 150 million, he added.
